record.name: Work boundary, allocation and organizational design
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: These design descriptions do not specify a sampling distribution, measurement calibration, physical failure probability, lawful risk threshold or demonstrated effect size. The work variables can define a statistical target where an explicit D rule does so.
record.receiving_questions: Which participants/functions/dependencies matter; what residual work is created; which allocation or analysis scope fits the actual work.
record.reentry_basis: A named work output becomes a measured construct, sampling unit, actual control duty or a particular shared resource.
record.semantic_offer: A work-system boundary, relevant constraints, residual tasks, allocation relationships or an explicit limit on using a taxonomy as a design prescription.

record.name: Representation, state, communication and effect semantics
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A legible representation or message does not originate a calibration chain, identify a statistical distribution, prove an effect or allocate a new legal duty. It can convey an already established input without manufacturing its truth.
record.receiving_questions: What a specific actor must distinguish or reconstruct, which source/state is meant, and how a command or message changes a consequential action.
record.reentry_basis: A specific datum, interface, pending obligation or shared control path makes the representation affect a receiving premise.
record.semantic_offer: Task-relative representations, current/pending/achieved-state distinctions, process expectations, source/uncertainty presentation and required communication timing.

record.name: Role, handoff and bounded adaptation
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A named authority does not supply an observation law, model accuracy or natural-system mechanism; an unresolved workload-inferred policy is not field validation. A statistical input can still constrain role feasibility.
record.receiving_questions: Whether the actor has rights, information, skill and time; when a transfer is accepted; which adaptation is permitted and realizable.
record.reentry_basis: A specified role consumes the evidence, performs the control, or changes the actual observation/evaluation design.
record.semantic_offer: Conditions for practical authority, actual intervention, transferable obligations and state-dependent allocation or procedural discretion.

record.name: Human capacity, recovery and learned competence
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A feasible cognitive schedule or trained confidence is not a probability estimate, acceleration law, hazard completeness certificate or authority grant. Existing criteria can define a relevant outcome without guaranteeing it.
record.receiving_questions: What can be performed now and by when; how skill or cue validity survives changed work; which peaks and recovery states matter.
record.reentry_basis: The same person/resource/cue process supplies a statistical unit, delayed action, safety duty or concrete transport question.
record.semantic_offer: Relevant skills/cues, engagement, interruption/resumption and shared time/resource requirements for actual work and recovery.

record.name: Reliance, grounding and diverse checking
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: More people, disagreement, confidence or grounding does not create independent sampled units, true physical redundancy, causal efficacy or current risk acceptance. Distinct information can still be a material partial input.
record.receiving_questions: Which claim is shared, which interpretation is distinct, what a cross-check adds and whether reliance/fallback matches current conditions.
record.reentry_basis: A named shared source, observation, failure class or practical checking duty connects the two records.
record.semantic_offer: Shared factual referents, calibrated reliance, distinct information/challenge and common-source/fallback limitations.

record.name: Alert routing and lifecycle
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: An alarm count or channel cannot specify a physical failure mechanism, validate a construct or establish clinical outcomes by itself. Threshold and observation/tail inputs are explicit positive exceptions.
record.receiving_questions: Which condition needs timely action, who can respond, what acknowledgement/resolution means and whether the alarm portfolio remains useful.
record.reentry_basis: The same detector, event population, response path or latent protective role is used by the other criterion.
record.semantic_offer: A condition/recipient/action/escalation/retirement relationship with attention and false/missed/late response consequences.

record.name: Work-as-done and learning
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A contextual narrative or rejection of terminal human-error labeling does not by itself identify a causal effect, sampling law, formal invariant or engineering control capability.
record.receiving_questions: What mechanism made the action plausible, what can change it and what evidence would establish that the action helped.
record.reentry_basis: A specified incident/report/outcome population or corrective-action mechanism is the receiving analysis object.
record.semantic_offer: Contemporaneous constraints, local rationality, causal rivals and action-linked learning with individual accountability retained.

record.name: Cognitive portfolio and artifact lifecycle
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A consumer or cheapness judgment cannot set a physical loss bound, erase a duty, establish evidence validity or supply a numeric expected utility without further premises.
record.receiving_questions: Whether another artifact or cognitive coordination layer adds a useful contribution under total burden and applicable duties.
record.reentry_basis: A concrete evidence/control portfolio shares the same resource, residual question, duty or latent consumer.
record.semantic_offer: Current or credible latent consumers, proportional support, attention cost and non-monotonic effects of information volume.

record.name: Joint evaluation, cognitive instruments and method bundles
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A method label, bundle or proxy score is not a supplied distribution, calibration, physical stress-to-use law or a universal intervention effect. The retained definitions can materially determine a study when explicitly matched.
record.receiving_questions: Which joint-system alternative, cognitive bearer, mechanism or distal outcome is being evaluated and what a component measure can mean.
record.reentry_basis: A stated statistical design, observation intervention or hazard-control evaluation measures this exact construct or bundle.
record.semantic_offer: Specific outcome/construct/recipient definitions and bounded claims for SA/workload measurement, EID, CRM or handoff bundles.

record.name: Measurement meaning and fitness
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: These conditions do not allocate an operator, teach task meaning, create a physical actuator, issue permission or validate every downstream outcome. They are not a universal metrology workflow.
record.receiving_questions: Which quantity/distinction is measured; whether the result supports this target and action; what model/reference or error scope is adequate.
record.reentry_basis: A named measured datum/construct, reference or decision margin enters the receiving mechanism.
record.semantic_offer: Definitions/conditions for construct, calibration, bias, discrimination, uncertainty, agreement, invariance, representative reference and purpose-relative adequacy.

record.name: Evidence identity, change and attribution
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: Version identity and reproducibility do not by themselves establish meaningful human interpretation, causal safety, physical behavior or lawfully authorized change.
record.receiving_questions: Which object/evaluator/version produced the result, what changed and what an independent bridge/discriminator can identify.
record.reentry_basis: The receiving claim actually relies on that changed/transferred evidence or shared evaluator.
record.semantic_offer: Provenance, evaluator/reference drift, candidate-versus-evaluator attribution and limits on treating reuse as fresh evidence.

record.name: Observation, units and dependence
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: Observation accounting does not create the unobserved phenomenon, a control right, correct interpretation or the physical control effect; dependence need not erase information.
record.receiving_questions: Which observations entered the inference, how they depend, what population they cover and how much information the actual design supplies.
record.reentry_basis: The receiving claim uses the same observed population, probe, source dependence or experimental unit.
record.semantic_offer: Selection/censoring/intervention, mixture and covariance models, assignment/sampling unit and conditional-information limitations.

record.name: Variation, detector and regime policy
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A signal does not identify cause or blame; a stable process is not compliance; a fitted detector does not make a person capable or implement a protective action.
record.receiving_questions: Which regime/requirement differs, which signal is calibrated and actionable, and whether intervention is warranted under actual costs.
record.reentry_basis: The same stream/threshold, response workload, requirement or credible containment purpose enters the receiver.
record.semantic_offer: Bounded change signals, regime/capability semantics, false/missed/delay tradeoffs and limits on reactive adjustment or blanket charts.

record.name: Experimental contrast and inferential guarantee
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A formal guarantee, randomization or response surface does not automatically supply human grounding, authority, hazard scope or physical realization. A pure theorem remains valid without an actual plant when its own premises hold.
record.receiving_questions: What comparison/target is identified and under which design/process/selection model; what uncertainty or threshold changes the decision.
record.reentry_basis: The receiver uses this exact target/design/guarantee or provides a named unit, constraint, alternative or deadline for it.
record.semantic_offer: Explicit alternatives/estimands, assignment/blocking, factorial/alias/local-response structure, effect margins, multiplicity/stopping and causal/transport sensitivity conditions.

record.name: Reliability, robustness, tails and transport
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A reliability number does not cover omitted nonfailure interactions; an acceleration law is not a cognitive learning model; a mean/tail estimate does not grant decision rights.
record.receiving_questions: Which failure/event, mission, noise factor, tail or distribution shift is covered and which physical/causal model supports transfer.
record.reentry_basis: The actual hazard/response/competence claim uses the same event, mission, stress mechanism, context or tail.
record.semantic_offer: Failure/exposure/censoring/stress mechanisms, separate mean/variance/tail/time/context claims, finite zero-event bounds and limits on recipe or growth extrapolation.

record.name: Lot disposition
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: Lot acceptance neither provides human expertise/grounding nor proves integrated control, process improvement, generic construct validity or all supplier risks.
record.prior_r5_semantic_offer: Sampling operating-characteristic/inspection-risk scope for a defined lot and the boundary between accepting a lot and improving a process.
record.r7_consumer_clarification: Actual inspection/correction work has distinct native consumers in a continuing lifecycle, sensitivity objective, checked goal/resource model, real reassignment, selected handoff content and actual controller state. Individual present-link guards govern; this is not a group-wide clique.
record.r8_consumer_clarification: Current C07 consumes bounded lot evidence in both action/context analysis and command-effect feedback. Its actual native partial inputs and independent purpose constraints are explicit; this does not create display, CWA, barrier, hazard-population, indicator or event consumers by group membership.
record.receiving_questions: Which lot/risk/inspection task is actually needed, and which process-feedback/corrective action and effectiveness claim are warranted at the specified scope?
record.reentry_basis: A supplier or integrated-control decision genuinely consumes that lot-disposition evidence or defines its relevant defect class.
record.semantic_offer: P026 supplies bounded lot-risk/inspection-error evidence and actual prespecified inspection work. P027 separately retains linked chronological process feedback, defect provenance and justified corrective work. Neither is reduced to the final accept/reject label, and neither proves the whole receiver.

record.name: Evidence choice, programme and proxy governance
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: Economic arithmetic or a programme label does not establish a true loss model, current authority, human capability or permission to waive categorical duties. A costly valid oracle need not be the best acquisition.
record.receiving_questions: Which feasible evidence or governance path changes a real decision at what total cost; which proxy or programme claim has actual mechanism and competence.
record.reentry_basis: The receiving portfolio, proxy or competence claim shares a named decision, scarce resource, actual duty or latent consumer.
record.semantic_offer: Prospective information/learning value, adequate exact discrimination, integrative strategy, control lifecycle and restrictions on metric/brand/credential substitution.

record.name: Loss and causal representation
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A hazard method or loss label does not supply empirical frequencies, the right cognitive display, observed behavior or a universal complete search. One adequate method can suffice.
record.receiving_questions: Which unacceptable loss and credible causal class need control and which representation can discriminate the actual question.
record.reentry_basis: A named loss, event class, task boundary or constraint becomes the receiving design/measurement target.
record.semantic_offer: A loss/hazard boundary and represented failure/deviation/control causal classes, with method coverage and control-hierarchy limits.

record.name: Control realization, time, state and envelope
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A written control requirement or safe-state label does not establish its sensor validity, human interpretation, physical actuation or real-time feasibility; no universal fail-safe/continued-operation rule.
record.receiving_questions: What state must be reached or maintained, by which controller, within what dependency/deadline/envelope, with what adequate evidence.
record.reentry_basis: The same observed state, human duty, transition, response resource or model/plant claim enters the receiver.
record.semantic_offer: Enforceable constraints, actual feedback/process-state/timing, human control, containment/degradation/restart and bounded adaptive/temporary configurations.

record.name: Legitimate authority, duties and resources
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A duty or acceptance is not a measurement calibration, stochastic law, cue validity theorem or permission outside its real jurisdiction. Institutional labels do not confer competence or low risk.
record.receiving_questions: Who may accept or act, which applicable duty constrains the choice and whether resources and rights match responsibility.
record.reentry_basis: A specific receiver decision is governed by that actual authority/duty or uses those same resources.
record.semantic_offer: Risk/control/temporary-state decision rights, regime-specific practicability/integrity obligations and organizational resource/production-pressure constraints.

record.name: Dependencies, assurance diversity and shared paths
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: Channel/reviewer count is not independence, while correlation does not imply zero value. A shared-path analysis does not invent sampling units, comprehension or an unrelated causal connection.
record.receiving_questions: What fails or changes together, which distinct evidence/function is credited and which actual shared interface can defeat it.
record.reentry_basis: The receiver claims the same source/channel independence, shared-path availability, supplier evidence or interface assumption.
record.semantic_offer: Interface assumptions, common cause, useful redundancy, informational/institutional assurance and safety-security/supplier paths.

record.name: Assurance claims, premises and currentness
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A coherent case, hash, link or certificate does not itself establish premise truth, a causal effect, independent study or human understanding. Theorem validity and actual-system applicability are separate.
record.receiving_questions: Which premise and evidence support this claim now, which change invalidates it and what decision consumes the assurance.
record.reentry_basis: The exact claim/evidence/currentness or correspondence premise changes the receiving analysis.
record.semantic_offer: Traceable bounded claims, defeaters, configuration/assumption currency, affected change, durable decision state and formal-evidence correspondence.

record.name: Risk and uncertainty interpretation
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: Risk categories or absence of events do not supply actual event probability, causal efficacy, natural-unit cardinal utility or comprehensive safety. Conditional probability learning remains legitimate.
record.receiving_questions: What can the stated risk evidence mean, which loss remains unknown and who owns acceptability beyond arithmetic.
record.reentry_basis: The receiver uses that same event population, consequence threshold, uncertainty or policy claim.
record.semantic_offer: Consequence/exposure/uncertainty and restrictions on ordinal score-as-truth, zero-events-as-control-proof and absolute-safety claims.

record.name: Reporting, investigation and adaptive programme claims
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: A culture score, incident narrative, report count or metaphor is not an identified effect, current state, physical failure law or independently tested whole-programme benefit.
record.receiving_questions: What occurred, what was reported, what mechanism/consumer can change it and what counts as verified corrective/adaptive performance.
record.reentry_basis: The receiving study or work design uses this actual report, action, incentive, mechanism or adaptation boundary.
record.semantic_offer: Observation/incentive-aware incident learning, causal control/action verification and limits on culture, metaphors or unspecified resilience.

record.name: Proportional control and lifecycle
record.noninferable_from_this_offer: Cheapness or dormant use does not determine all hazard probabilities, excuse missing coverage or grant waiver authority; maximal process is not automatically safer.
record.receiving_questions: What additional control/evidence is necessary under real uncertainty and duties, what burden it creates and what latent demand remains.
record.reentry_basis: The receiver shares this actual decision/portfolio, constraint, resource or latent protection function.
record.semantic_offer: Consequence/reversibility/coupling tailoring, adequate cheap paths, meaningful actual/latent consumers and justified retirement.

encoding: Repeated exact values use $scientific_ref, resolved through shared-records.json definitions. References preserve every value; they do not create scientific evidence.
